leads.name: Flagstaff Junior High School Moon Tree (Douglas fir)
leads.reason: BLOCKED: NASA record: Douglas fir planted 30 Apr 1976 near Frances Short Pond; Wikipedia's moon-tree table marks it dead; a Bicentennial Moon Tree at 755 N Bonito St only 'represents' the original per its sign (search summary). Not the original; not an ancient tree.

leads.name: Mars Hill 'grandmother tree' ponderosa
leads.reason: Lead: Arizona Highways essay (Annette McGivney, fetched via web.archive.org): ponderosa near the top of Mars Hill, ~150 ft tall, 'at least 400 or maybe 500 years' per scientists the author consulted, on a slope well away from established trails. No coordinate, and the author does not give one; the Mars Hill trail system is Lowell Observatory/city land. No exact pin in reach.

leads.name: Ponderosa at the Arizona Historical Society Pioneer Museum, Flagstaff
leads.reason: Lead: a 2016 treesdb.org measurement lists a ponderosa on the museum grounds, ~100 ft and 161 in girth (search result only, not fetched). Needs the page read, a pin and an access check.
